dimensions.assessment: Affects public safety telecommunicators nationwide, communications providers, and areas experiencing extended communications outages.
dimensions.evidence: categorize public safety telecommunicators as a protective service occupation under the Standard Occupational Classification system

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new reporting, hearing, and occupational reclassification mandates without altering core commercial operations directly beyond compliance.
dimensions.evidence: Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall... categorize public safety telecommunicators as a protective service occupation

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for FCC reports and hearings and OMB reclassification, but no specific spending amounts are provided.
Directs multiple federal agency reporting and administrative actions across telecommunications and occupational classification systems.
dimensions.evidence: To direct the Federal Communications Commission to issue reports after activation of the Disaster Information Reporting System

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual hearing and reporting requirements alongside one-time administrative reclassifications and study reports.
dimensions.evidence: Each year, the Commission shall hold not less than 1 public hearing

missing_information: Federal administrative cost estimates for conducting the mandated studies and hearings
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the FCC to hold public hearings and issue reports after extended DIRS activations, investigate 911 outage reporting, reclassify public safety telecommunicators, and report on Kari's Law enforcement.
